narratives.title: For creators and editors
narratives.summary: When the intake or profile lane begins to roughen, the output usually stops sounding like a nuanced audience and starts sounding like a narrow loop.
narratives.consequence: The cost is not only technical. Repetition flattens taste, reduces surprise, and makes a catalogue feel smaller than it is.
narratives.continuation: 324 connector runs and 7 typed connector kinds mean the repo can start from rows, contracts, and public pages before tensor work begins.

narratives.title: For operators and review teams
narratives.summary: Replay parity, proof exports, and job records make it easier to answer what moved, what failed, and what deserves another pass.
narratives.consequence: That shortens the distance between an incident, a rerun, and a clear decision about whether the lane can keep moving.
narratives.continuation: It shows how to keep ingestion, schema care, and tensor preparation in one chain without hiding the transformations.

narratives.title: For researchers and model builders
narratives.summary: It gives the repository one serious multimodal model that can be discussed in terms of routing, fusion discipline, and uncertainty without requiring the public runtime to pretend every research branch is production-ready.
narratives.consequence: That makes the repo more useful as a place to compare mechanisms, not only outputs.
narratives.continuation: Add evaluated transcript-plus-frame corpora with stronger long-range temporal supervision.
